parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time of the query range. Specify the time in UTC format.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. The value must be a positive integer. The default is 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time of the query range. Specify the time in UTC format.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The task statuses.

> If you omit this parameter, the operation returns tasks of all statuses.

parameters.name: TaskType
parameters.description: The type of the batch task.
